verdict.rationale: Entra docs confirm that device identities feed device-based Conditional Access policies and that Conditional Access can gate application access [docs-8, docs-22, docs-16, docs-2]. Device management depends on the separate Intune product, and the pack never shows that posture attributes like encryption or screen lock are evaluated in the policy. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of compliant-device or posture conditions (managed, encrypted, screen-locked) evaluated at sign-in, posture checks without relying on Intune, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
